prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE low-resolution top-down RPG map NPC standing sprite, Mara, independently composed for 35 by 44 pixels.
Primary request: Make a deliberately tiny 35-column by 44-row pixel-art character with just a few large flat clusters, displayed as an enlarged sprite. NOT a large detailed figure later scaled down. Each logical pixel should be a consistent square, no grid lines. The character occupies roughly 27 columns and 41 rows with transparent margins. Single standing frame only.
Input image 1: style reference montage, especially the small native map figures in its top reference row and v4 Mara sprite at bottom. Follow economical proportions and strong outline, NOT the portrait composition.
Input image 2: identity and outfit continuity ONLY. Its face and hair details must NOT be carried into the tiny map sprite.
Input image 3: established outfit identity ONLY, not its tall silhouette or detailed curls.
Subject: Mara, a mature woman in her thirties, an ordinary ropeworker. Upright, still and guarded; not smiling, not a child. Brown low-pinned hair with two or three broad locks and small low bun; dusty red scarf at neck; ochre thick-cloth dress with light worn sleeves; clearly separate beige ropework apron at waist; short dark-brown boots. A single small unfinished rope loop hangs alongside one hand, subordinate and inside the broad body silhouette. No weapon, jewelry, large bags or extra props.
Camera and framing: neutral map standing pose, full body all boots visible, very slightly three-quarter facing toward screen-left; mild high view suitable for a top-down map. Entire head height about 16 of 44 grid rows, torso-and-apron about 16 rows, short legs/boots about 7 rows. Wide readable outline and short sturdy limbs. Head is mature but compact; tiny eyes are short dark marks without large white sclera or glitter. Arms rest down, feet slightly apart, no gesture/action, no walking sequence.
Art direction: near-black #211b22 one-logical-pixel perimeter, mostly continuous outer outline. Broad hard clusters, tiny structural skin planes only, at most 20 flat opaque colors; 4 skin shades, 3 brown hair shades, 2 scarf reds, 3 beige apron shades, ochre cloth, pale sleeves and dark boots. The red scarf and beige apron must both read at 1x. Minimize all small marks so the image is intelligible at 35x44. No dithering, gradients, soft or antialiased edges, fine line art, wrinkles, individual hairs, speckle/noise, realistic rendering, doll face, scenery, base, ground shadow, contact shadow, text, labels, frame, grid or montage.
Output: one transparent PNG map sprite only, real transparent background. Preserve hard square pixel shapes and alpha edges.
